Name: Helem
Summary: Brother of Shamer and father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:35: Brother of Shamer and father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
LifeLesson: The mention of Helem in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
